title: ClarificationResponse
description: The user's answers to one consolidated ClarificationRequest round. The root agent asks the questions through its native user-interaction tool and submits this document. Include one entry per question in the request, echoing its `id`. Never invent answers on the user's behalf: if the user did not answer, use `skipped`; if they explicitly refused, use `declined`.

round.description: Copy exactly from the ClarificationRequest (1-based; at most 3 rounds per run).

answers.description: One entry per question of the request.

questionId.description: The `id` of the question being answered (e.g. `q_1a2b3c4d5e6f`).

answer.description: The user's answer, verbatim or faithfully summarised. Required (non-empty) when status is `answered`; omit otherwise.

status.description: `answered`: the user answered. `declined`: the user explicitly chose not to answer (it will not be asked again; a documented assumption is used instead). `skipped`: the user did not respond to this question.
